cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Nothing Without Stakes
cards.instruction: Price every request and decision with a reward, penalty, bargain, or trade.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. If I apologise first, what do I win?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. And if your apology follows, do we split the victory?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then why is going first carrying all the risk?

mechanism: A supervises apology timing as a bargain with reciprocal risk, pricing even the request to end an argument.
confusable: D184 asks admission before own disclosure; D214 requires an exchange value for each conciliatory action.
comparison: Emotional negotiation differs from lending equipment.
seedUse: Keep end-argument offer and first-mover concern; establish what disagreement and a concrete reciprocal term.
